description:
YouTube channel info by handle, channel ID or URL: title, description, approximate subscriber/video counts, avatar and banner.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `username` OR `channel`.
Returns: channel_id (string, nullable), handle (string, nullable), title (string), description (string), keywords (string), subscriber_count (integer, nullable), subscriber_count_text (string, nullable), video_count (integer, nullable), video_count_text (string, nullable), is_family_safe (boolean), channel_url (string, nullable), avatar_url (string, nullable), banner_url (string, nullable), available_countries (integer, nullable).

channel.description: Alias of username (same accepted formats). Example: "UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuVA"

username.description: Channel @handle, handle, channel ID or channel URL. Example: "@MrBeast"

name: youtube_profile
title: YouTube channel
